description: Add support for OpenAI's tool search feature to the LangChain OpenAI integration. This feature enables the model to search for and select appropriate tools during conversations. The implementation should include proper type translations to v1 OpenAI types and support client-side tool search via middleware.
functional_requirements: Implement OpenAI tool search functionality in the chat models module
Add proper translation between LangChain tool definitions and OpenAI v1 API types
Support client-side tool search execution through middleware integration
Update test infrastructure to verify tool search behavior in both regular and streaming modes
Ensure compatibility with existing agent loop functionality when tool search is enabled
Add comprehensive unit and integration tests for the new tool search feature
